subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and cancel/steer/resume supervision extend the existing audit/task/artifact foundations, live in a separate subagent-specific ledger/API, or be deferred to summaries only?
rationale: The choice fixes public operator permissions, redaction, retention, persisted data shape, artifact exposure, and cross-session control semantics, which automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Extend audit/task foundations
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, and artifact lookup surfaces.

options.title: Create subagent ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent lifecycle and supervision table/API, accepting another durable source of truth for this workflow.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Decline the durable receipt/control contract for now and keep audit.list, task summaries, artifacts, and visibility commands as separate operator tools.

recommendation.title: Extend audit/task foundations
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, and artifact lookup surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest verified history across subagent control, task lifecycle seams, and the adjacent audit design decision.
